from harness import *
import json, subprocess, sys, os
E = {"status": "reject", "reason": "syntax"}
U = {"status": "reject", "reason": "unauthenticated"}
I = {"status": "reject", "reason": "identity"}
DIR = {"sip:ember@studio.test": ["sip:e1@alias.studio.test", "tel:+12025550121"],
       "sip:desk@sales.test": ["tel:+12025550122"]}
ACC = {"s1": {"primary":"sip:ember@studio.test","allow":["sip:desk@sales.test"]}}
GW = {"edge": {"local_domains":["studio.test","sales.test"],"peers":{"edge":["studio.test","sales.test"]}},
      "inside": {"local_domains":[],"peers":{"edge":["studio.test","sales.test"]}}}
LOC = {"kind":"local","subject":"s1"}
PE = {"kind":"peer","name":"edge"}
def J(raw, gw="edge", ingress=LOC, trusted_out=True):
    return one(raw=raw, gateway_name=gw, ingress=ingress, trusted_out=trusted_out,
               directory=DIR, accounts=ACC, gateways=GW)
def R(*lines, body=""):
    return "\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n\r\n" + body
cases=[]
def C(n,g,w): cases.append((n,g,w))

base = ["MESSAGE sip:i@r.t SIP/2.0",
        "From: \"Doe, John\" <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7",
        "To: sip:inbox@relay.test",
        "Call-ID: c", "CSeq: 1 MESSAGE", "Content-Length: 0"]
C("pai quoted display comma", sub(J(R(*base, extra="")), "identity"), "sip:ember@studio.test")
b2 = base[:1] + ["P-Asserted-Identity: \"Doe, \\\"J\\\"\" <sip:desk@sales.test>, <tel:+12025550121>"] + base[1:]
C("pai list with quoted commas", sub(J(R(*b2), gw="inside", ingress=PE), "reason"), "identity")
b3 = [l for l in b2 if not l.startswith("From")] + ["From: <sip:desk@sales.test>;tag=q7"]
C("pai quoted display with escape", sub(J(R(*b3), gw="inside", ingress=PE), "identity"), "sip:desk@sales.test")
# chain: local private -> peer -> peer
raw1 = R("MESSAGE sip:i@r.t SIP/2.0","From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=a","To: <sip:i@r.t>",
          "Call-ID: c","CSeq: 1 MESSAGE","Privacy: id","Content-Length: 0")
res = run(batch([{"gateway":"edge","ingress":LOC,"trusted_out":False,"raw":raw1},
                 {"gateway":"inside","ingress":PE,"trusted_out":True,"source":0},
                 {"gateway":"inside","ingress":PE,"trusted_out":False,"source":1},
                 {"gateway":"inside","ingress":PE,"trusted_out":True,"source":2}],
                directory=DIR, accounts=ACC, gateways=GW))["results"]
C("chain hop1", (res[0]["status"], res[0]["private"], "P-Asserted-Identity" in res[0]["wire"]), ("accept",True,False))
C("chain hop2", (res[1]["status"], res[1]["basis"], res[1]["private"], "P-Asserted-Identity" in res[1]["wire"]), ("accept","peer",True,True))
C("chain hop3", res[2], {"status":"reject","reason":"unauthenticated"})
# CLI level
env=dict(os.environ)
data=json.dumps(batch([{"gateway":"edge","ingress":LOC,"trusted_out":True,"raw":raw1},
                       {"gateway":"inside","ingress":PE,"trusted_out":True,"source":0}],
                      directory=DIR, accounts=ACC, gateways=GW)).encode()
out=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/workspace/submission/gateway.py"],input=data,capture_output=True)
got=json.loads(out.stdout.decode())
C("cli exit 0", out.returncode, 0)
C("cli keys", sorted(got.keys()), ["results"])
C("cli result keys", [sorted(r.keys()) for r in got["results"]],
  [["basis","identity","private","status","wire"],["basis","identity","private","status","wire"]])
C("cli stderr empty", out.stderr, b"")
out2=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/workspace/submission/gateway.py"],input=b"",capture_output=True)
C("cli empty stdin", (out2.returncode, json.loads(out2.stdout)), (0, {"results": []}))
out3=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/workspace/submission/gateway.py"],input=b"{not json",capture_output=True)
C("cli bad json", (out3.returncode, json.loads(out3.stdout)), (0, {"results": []}))
out4=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/workspace/submission/gateway.py"],input=b'{"jobs":[]}',capture_output=True)
C("cli empty jobs", json.loads(out4.stdout), {"results": []})
# tag token chars in PAI display, folded singleton, and display-only From
C("folded privacy", sub(J(R("MESSAGE sip:i@r.t SIP/2.0","From: <sip:ember@studio.test>","To: <sip:i@r.t>",
                            "Call-ID: c","CSeq: 1 MESSAGE","Privacy:"," id","Content-Length: 0")), "private"), True)
C("display only", J(R("MESSAGE sip:i@r.t SIP/2.0","From: Alice","To: <sip:i@r.t>","Call-ID: c","CSeq: 1 MESSAGE","Content-Length: 0")), E)
C("empty display brackets", J(R("MESSAGE sip:i@r.t SIP/2.0","From: \"\" <sip:ember@studio.test>","To: <sip:i@r.t>","Call-ID: c","CSeq: 1 MESSAGE","Content-Length: 0"))["status"], "accept")
C("multi token display tel", sub(J(R("MESSAGE sip:i@r.t SIP/2.0","From: a b c <tel:+12025550121>","To: <sip:i@r.t>","Call-ID: c","CSeq: 1 MESSAGE","Content-Length: 0")), "identity"), "sip:ember@studio.test")
fails=0
for n,g,w in cases:
    if g!=w:
        fails+=1; print("FAIL %-32s got=%r want=%r"%(n,g,w))
print("cases",len(cases),"failures",fails)
PYEOF
